message.snippet: Hi John, thanks for booking the Lantern security assessment. Complete the scan setup form linked below so the team can begin. Scans usually take 2 to 4 weeks from setup.

answer.body:
Hi John,

Thanks for booking the Lantern security assessment. Complete the scan setup form linked below so the team can begin.

Scan setup form: https://portal.shieldline.example/setup/lantern-2026-11

The form asks for your environment details, the list of in-scope hosts and domains, and a technical contact for the scan window. Scans usually take 2 to 4 weeks from setup. You'll get an email in the client portal when results are ready.

If you have questions, reply to this email or call the onboarding desk at 555-0142.

Thanks,
Shieldline Onboarding
onboarding@shieldline.example

message.subject: Scan setup form for Lantern
message.snippet: Thanks for booking your Lantern assessment. Please complete the scan setup form so we can connect to your staging and production environments. Reply with the requested access details or fill in the attached form by Nov 6.

answer.body:
Hi John,

Thanks for booking your Lantern assessment. Your booking reference is SL-2026-11-0457.

Next step: please complete the scan setup form so we can connect to your staging and production environments. The form is attached to this email (Lantern_Scan_Setup.pdf). You can also reply with the requested access details if you'd rather not use the form. We'll need:

- Staging and production base URLs
- A read-only service account or API token for each environment
- Two IP ranges or hostnames we should allow-list for scanning
- A technical contact for scan-day questions

Please send everything by Nov 6 so we can schedule the scan window. Missing items will push the start date back.

If you have questions, reply to this email or call our onboarding line at 555-0142.

Best,
Dana Whitfield
Onboarding Coordinator, Shieldline
onboarding@shieldline.example
